{{Quote|The storm's eased enough for me to use our emergency snow flyer to deliver you on to the Empire's Polar Base!|[[Odan (impostor)|Imperial Commander]]|<ref name="Showdown">{{StoryCite|story=Showdown (Pizzazz)|book=Pizzazz 16}}</ref>}}
'''Polar Base''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] command center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Akuria II]]. The facility was run by an [[Odan (impostor)|unidentified Imperial commander]] who used the base as a staging point for attacks against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Odan]]. The Imperial installation was eventually destroyed during the [[Mission to Akuria II]], when the native population of [[Akurian]]s attacked the fortress. Rebel heroes [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] played a pivotal role in the base's destruction when they commandeered Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and destroyed the base's outer walls, killing the Imperial commander in the process.
